extraction: Upstream FITS as shipped. Single bintable HDU1. Companion TSV written alongside.
note: Abell 2029. XMM-Newton EPIC spectral fits in concentric annuli (X-COP). KT is the PROJECTED (spectroscopic, along the line of sight) temperature in keV -- it is NOT deprojected. Annuli span 0.00-17.0 arcmin; at z=0.0766 (1 arcmin ~= 87.2 kpc) that is ~0-1482 kpc. NO core excision: the innermost annulus runs from 0.0 arcmin. This is the file that carries T(r) in PHYSICAL units (keV); A2029_temperature.fits carries the same information scaled to T/T500. NORM is the XSPEC APEC normalisation, ZFE the Fe abundance.
